reuse_policy: Reuse compatible retained 25 C data and validated P2 cases; do not rerun completed physical cases.
temperature_policy: Only simulator temperature changes; nominal VDD=1.10 V, TT, healthy waveform and process seed mapping remain fixed.
threshold_policy: Only diagnostic T_POS_RISE=18/19 and fixed BFE13 probe T_TRACK=5/B_TRACK=2 are allowed; no production selection.
